avis.texte: I have been using my Curology custom formula since 2020 and my provider has recommended me to use Bioderma Micellar Warte to remove my makeup before using my treatment but I came across their micellar here in Amazon for half of the price I would pay for the Bioderma one. I have to say I really like this one. I can easily remove waterproof makeup and my skin feels moisturized and not sticky as I thought I could get due to the gel like texture of it.

I bought this make up remover after having purchased Thrive Causmetics mascara and read that the mascara can be difficult to remove. This works well. I have to be careful though as it stings. It works great in foundation and eyebrow tint.

Takes off waterproof mascara so easily. No residue feeling nor greasy feeling on your eyes. Love the consistency. Bought this last October and I only use this for my eye makeup and I have probably 3/4 left. I could use this for my whole face but I have other things I’m using first. Highly recommend! Definitely a staple for me now.

I bought this to remove eye makeup and it worked well. It removed all of my shadow, liner, and mascara in 10 seconds. Required a good warm water rinse after so no irritation after. I applied it using cotton rounds on tightly closed eyes. The real joy came when I used it on my face to remove sunscreen. My skin felt so refreshed and actually moisturized. The texture is unlike anything I've tried before. It's a gel. Unscented. Doesn't strip the skin. I never wear waterproof mascara so your mileage will vary.
Love this. It took off makeup so much better than Micellar Water. I'll definitely be buying again.

I bought this as an eye makeup remover. I applied to a cotton pad and gently wiped over my closed eyes. My eyes began to burn and continued till I put multiple refresh eye drops in my eyes. The drops minimized the burning but I still have discomfort! There’s no way I would ever use this product again.
I bought this after regular micellar water dried out my skin. This cleanser is definitely thicker than what I’m used to but I just rinse with water after use. So far it has not dried out my face.
This is the best makeup remover, a little goes a long way so it will last you for a few months I would say. Great for sensitive skin and also doesn’t leave any weird residue on the skin.

Review: Curology Micellar Water Makeup Remover, Waterproof Eye and Face Make Up Lifting Cleanser, Gentle and Hydrating, 8.5 fl oz 🏎️ Quick Rec: Buy if you like the brand Curology & are OK with the price point. 📝 Additional Notes: ✅ Pros ✅ - It is almost like a gel consistency, different than other micellar waters I’ve used. It helps not run everywhere. - You can use it & not have to wash your face after, great if you are in a rush. - No negative skin reactions here to the product, may be good to try this if you have sensitive skin. ❌ Cons ❌ - The bottle at ~$11 is more expensive than others in the market, but the product is top shelf, high quality. You get what you pay for. 🔢 My Scoring: Cleanliness 🫧🫧🫧🫧🫧 Value for Price 🪙🪙🪙🪙 Utility 🦺🦺🦺🦺🦺

avis.titre: Love the consistency; have a hard time opening the bottle
avis.texte: I ordered this micellar water makeup remover and have been using it for a few weeks now. It does a great job of taking off makeup and sunscreen. I really like the consistency. Most micellar water products are very thin and watery, but this one is a bit thicker. I much prefer this, as I am less wasteful with the product. It passed the initial skin patch test, and I've had no problems with sensitivity while using it. Makeup removal products can be quite rough on my skin, so I'm happy about this. The bottle is thick, which is my biggest problem. It is difficult for my tiny, arthritic hands to hold and also unscrew the top.
This gentle cleanser works well for removing make up and leaving my face feeling fresh and clean. The smell is subtle and it’s almost like using water only on my face.

avis.titre: Works amazing with no oily residue!
avis.texte: It’s so hard for me to find a makeup remover that is gentle, works well, and doesn’t leave an oily residue. I think I found my new favorite makeup remover! - A little goes a long way. Just a small amount and I was able to take off all my eye makeup remover with just one cotton pad - No residue. Once dried I didn’t have oily residue. - Gentle on the skin. I didn’t have to rub to get the makeup off, and my skin feels very soft after! - No smells!

This has to be one of the best makeup removers I have ever tried. It quickly removed my eye makeup without having to tug or keep going back. The formula is very lightweight and it’s perfect for sensitive skin. I am really impressed with it! I would definitely get it again because it’s not like anything I have tried before. 5 stars!

This Curology Micellar Water Makeup Remover works wonders on waterproof makeup. It is a nice cleanser to take off daily makeup. It was very gentle on my skin. It doesn’t leave a residue behind and leaves your fact feeling completely clean. It was hydrating and worth the value.
